ops.title: Codex fleet packaging review: release launchers and marketplace loss
ops.body: Independent read-only review of the cc-skills Codex fleet candidate found five actionable defects. The highest-risk failures are optional external binary overlays that preserve release-download launchers, and build-claude rebuilding an incomplete marketplace instead of preserving the source definition. The attached report contains triggers, impacts, fixes, evidence, refutations, test results, and review limits.
